name: Imperial Palace
description: The palace on Kamigawa where Kaito trained.

timeline.summary: Two visions of freedom clash at the gates of the Imperial Palace.
timeline.quote: Two different visions of freedom clashed at the gates of the Imperial Palace.

citation.text: Eiganjo Uprising (Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Swift-Arm was assigned to oversee Kaito's training after Light-Paws decided Kaito and Eiko should no longer be sparring partners.
timeline.quote: he was assigned to oversee Kaito's training after Light-Paws decided that Kaito and his sister, Eiko , should no longer be sparring partners
